LanguageData.Gun_Ithaca_37_Trench_RWP.label: Ithaca 37 Trench
LanguageData.Gun_Ithaca_37_Trench_RWP.description: The Ithaca 37 Trench is a reliable pump-action shotgun, renowned for its durability and swift operation in close combat situations. Its rugged design and rapid fire make it a formidable choice for defense and assaults within confined spaces.
